notes.title: New Iron Frontier Demo for Yogcast’s Tiny Teams Event!
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Iron Frontier is featured in the Tiny Teams showcase by Yogscast! It’s an honor to be part of this event![/p][p]We released an extended demo with loads of new features, enhanced graphics and balance, new upgrades and tons of quality of life improvements![/p][p]Feel free to destroy the enemy and provide us with valuable feedback, what do you think about it!  Join our Discord channel to stay tuned. And wishlist the game![/p][p]See you on a battlefield![/p][p]Over and out.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43127140/393b9c5903e8723a7f82246e0fb9ab3f1e73682f.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 5000 fighters on the frontier! Recruitment continues!
notes.content:
Iron Frontier wishlists number has exceeded 5,000!
Thank you for your support! Every fighter is important for us, we are happy to see you in our ranks!
But the battle continues, and we need reinforcements! Do you have friends ready to stand up to the enemy? Invite them to Iron Frontier! Let's win together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43127140/8213b2b146711ad7d1d3ff28b65d78cc7764af94.gif[/img]

notes.title: New demo version with laser weapons is available!
notes.content:
We've just released a new demo version with laser weapons, drone swarms and GIANT zeppelin!
Any feedback is welcome! You can use 'Feedback' button in the main menu to tell us your thought about the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43127140/4bb291fa657e20f79a8741ce1f0f36c5f4b2c0ad.png[/img]

notes.title: Iron Frontier will feature weather effects
notes.content:
Weather will be a factor to consider in Iron Frontier! Snowstorm will freeze units. Rain will occasionally spawn lightning strikes. Dust storms will limit units range of fire.
We are aiming to add as much variety to the gameplay as possible. Stay tuned!

[previewyoutube=fZ05sIQFYKo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Big success at Dark Matters showcase!
notes.content:
I'm happy to report that Iron Frontier showcase at Dark Matters Expo was a hufe success! Dozens of people played our game and provided us with incredible feedback! Looking on players actions I finally figured out how to increase gameplay pace without breaking the balance. Playtests results are very inspiring! Expect a new free demo with extra features and content soon! And don't forget to support us by [b]wishlisting the game[/b] right now!
[previewyoutube=U5BPEh5T63c;full][/previewyoutube]
Bibamus out!

notes.title: Iron Frontier is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43127140/f0cd6434ca9177beb642e65e7263948f0ba0084a.gif[/img]

Bibamus reporting! It’s been a while since our last announcement. We are happy to report that the development of Iron Frontier is going full steam ahead! We’ve added tons of great stuff into the game including new features, dozens of upgrades and cool units like dogs, paratroopers and exoskeletons. Right now we are working on balancing new content and bug fixing the game. Our next goal is to create a new playable build to collect some feedback about our latest improvements. Stay tuned!
Bibamus out.
